This is an actual Push and can trigger applicable movement effects, unlike later cleanup. Failed Drowning yields no Energy. requested_parts: Bringer uses a 2-Damage Power and then a separate 1-Damage Power on an undamaged City.
What happens?
What if 2 then 1 Damage are instructions within a single Power
and may a Repeat pretend-destroy the same piece again?
answers.answer: Separate Bringer Power uses cannot combine hypothetical Damage: the first 2-Damage Power does not destroy the undamaged City, and the later separate 1-Damage Power does not either. Within one Power use, its 2 and 1 Damage instructions can combine to pretend-destroy a City for 5 Fear; a Repeat may pretend-destroy it again.

evidence.text: - **Bringer of Dreams and Nightmares:** Its Powers' explicit Damage/Destroy cannot actually harm Invaders/Dahan or destroy anything except its own Presence. An explicit instruction to Damage or Destroy Dahan does nothing to those Dahan; skip that instruction and resolve the rest of the Power normally. For each Power use, evaluate what it would destroy if resolved normally: generate **0 Fear per Explorer, 2 per Town, 5 per City**, and Push the would-be-destroyed Explorers/Towns. No real Damage is marked, so different Powers or a Repeat cannot combine their hypothetical Damage; multiple instructions **within one Power** can. Existing real Damage from others helps its hypothetical destruction and remains unchanged afterward. Within a single Power use, a given Invader can be pretend-destroyed only once. Repeats can “destroy” the same piece again for Fear. It does not get bonuses conditional on **actual** destruction (e.g., Mists of Oblivion or Vengeance of the Dead) from these pretend destructions.
